purpose: Define the closed conformance-only control and identity derivations for the executable Stage 2 processing-failure vector.

semantics: The control is conformance authority and is not part of Stage 2 request bytes.
The control must be passed explicitly by vector tooling.
Production request processing must not infer this control from payload content, identifiers, environment variables, or incidental exceptions.
The controlled failure occurs only after request, workflow, operation, result, and diagnostic identities can be constructed truthfully.

result_construction_boundary.text: This issue defines only the executable no-op-disposition processing-failure vector. Authoritative and fatal result-construction fault injection remain separately governed and must not be inferred from this control.
